turns.question: Which day of the week had the highest average daily ad spend across all campaigns in September 2026, and what was that average in EUR?
turns.answer: Over 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30, Thursday had the highest average daily ad spend across all campaigns: 215 EUR per day (its four Thursdays totalled 860 EUR in the query; I divided that query total by four myself, as the semantic layer has no weekday average).
